claims.claim_text: Case Number: SC-059
Date of Incident: December 30, 2022
Time of Incident: Approximately 1553 hours
Location: 100 block of 12th Street, Seal Beach, CA
Reporting Officer: Officer F. Goodwin
Badge Number: 3298
Subject: Craig Holloway, Male, approximately 50, White
Officer(s): Officer F. Goodwin, Officer H. Nakamura
Witness(es): W-1 (neighbor who called 911)

On December 30, 2022, at approximately 1553 hours, Officer Nakamura and I responded to a 911 call regarding a male subject described as being outside a residence appearing intoxicated and possibly armed.
The caller, W-1, a neighbor, described the subject as a white male in his fifties holding a can.
Upon arrival, I observed the subject standing on the front walkway of the residence holding what appeared to be a beer can in his left hand.
His right hand was at his side.
I identified myself as Seal Beach Police and instructed the subject to place his hands where I could see them.
The subject stared at us but did not comply.
The subject turned and walked toward the front door.
As he reached the porch area, he reached into the right pocket of his jacket and produced a black semi-automatic handgun.
Officer Nakamura deployed his TASER, striking the subject in the torso.
The subject fell backward against the door frame but remained standing.
The subject raised the handgun and pointed it in our direction.
I discharged my firearm twelve times.
Officer Nakamura discharged his firearm nine times.
The subject fell to the ground on his back on the porch.
We approached cautiously.
The subject was still holding the handgun.
Officer Nakamura kicked the weapon away from the subject's hand.
We immediately began rendering medical aid.
Seal Beach Fire Department paramedics arrived at approximately 1610 hours and provided additional medical treatment.
The subject was pronounced deceased at the scene.
The handgun recovered from the scene was determined to be registered to the subject's father.
The weapon was loaded with a round in the chamber.
Body-worn camera footage
Twenty-one (21) cartridge cases
One (1) semi-automatic handgun
One (1) TASER cartridge
Subject pronounced deceased at scene.
Scene secured for investigation.
Officer Signature: Goodwin
Date of Report: December 30, 2022
